name: Tama Kagura ~Funtouki~
source:
Yuma Nagumo, a young freelance exorcist, struggles between his own ideals and the harsh reality of life around him.

When his childhood friend Yukari Kaburagi suddenly gains exorcist powers of her own, Yuma at first tries to keep her out of the fray… but after some unexpected twists and turns, the two agree to fight yokai side-by-side in the village of Inakibi. Soon another priestess—Chihaya Inudoh, from Kijimori Shrine—joins their party to complete her exorcist training, and the trio set out on their journey together! As more and more urgent quests pour in, they protect the peace of the land from evil, but a terrible threat rises to stand in their way…

[From [url=https://shiravune.com/archives/2424]Shiravune[/url]]
translation:
年轻的自由职业退魔士南云佑马，徘徊于自己的理想与周遭生活的严酷现实之间。

青梅竹马镝木紫突然获得退魔之力后，佑马起初试图让她远离战斗……但经历了一番意外波折，两人最终约定，以稻黍村为据点，并肩对抗妖怪。不久，来自雉杜神社的另一位巫女犬童千早，为完成退魔修行，也加入了他们的队伍。三人就此踏上共同的旅程！随着紧急委托不断涌来，他们驱逐邪恶，守护这片土地的安宁。然而，一股可怕的威胁，正在前方等待着他们……
